paragraphs: I'm applying for the Senior C# / VB.NET Engineer role at Intogreat Solutions. The insurance-application focus of this role lines up directly with what I do today: I'm a Senior Developer building and scaling a live insurance platform.

At Delta Insurance, I drive end-to-end development across a legacy .NET Framework application and a modern 5-microservice .NET Core backend, while providing technical governance by reviewing peer developers' architecture and code. I also author automated test coverage with Jest, Testing Library, and Playwright, and mentor through code review — matching the coaching and quality-ownership this role expects. Earlier, at Beeline, I worked with Vue.js and REST APIs across an Oracle and SQL Server database landscape, and I've used JIRA and Git-based Agile workflows throughout my career.
I'd welcome the opportunity to bring that same combination of hands-on .NET development and quality-focused mentorship to your insurance application team. Thank you for your time and consideration.
